title: Westfield Bondi Level 6 redevelopment
long_term_impact: Expanded dining entertainment and lifestyle offer
summary: A $240 million redevelopment is under construction and planned to open in stages from late Q4 2026.

title: Westfield Penrith entertainment precinct redevelopment
summary: Scentre Group reports that its $30 million redevelopment of the entertainment and lifestyle precinct and HOYTS complex commenced in 2026.

title: Westfield Warringah Mall town-centre concept
summary: Scentre Group reports substantially progressed concept plans for a new town centre with potential for up to 1600 dwellings.

title: Westfield Eastgardens mixed-use exploration
summary: Scentre Group reports that an integrated mixed-use opportunity including 1300 dwellings is being explored.

title: Resido at Sylvia Park
long_term_impact: 295 apartments adjoining the retail and transport precinct
summary: Kiwi Property reports that the 295-apartment build-to-rent development beside Sylvia Park completed in 2024.

title: Chadstone Market Pavilion
long_term_impact: Expanded premium fresh food dining and lifestyle offer
summary: Vicinity reports that the 20000 sqm Market Pavilion opened in March 2025 with more than 60 retailers.
